differences: Current public ProjectApi::init combines fresh Disposable Store creation, canonical namespace construction, first Branch and consuming seal. The frozen initialize_layerstack timer starts after Store/client setup and returns a genesis Layer; both contain the complete original native import, and their raw scopes remain distinct.

Current Init remains a fresh host public call. Its independent verifier preserves the original Store reconnect, public Fork from exact imported Layer, fresh FUSE mount, complete original native check and terminal End/Gone/fences/KnownStop. Additional offline authenticated typed storage proof covers every original path and byte plus exhaustive inode membership; installation and all cleanup belong to the original independent proof budget.

Independent original CDC boundaries, full payload spans, identical/repeated-base sharing and distinct-base disjointness remain mandatory. Current typed payload and file content identities replace retired encoded ObjectId comparison; exact retired encoding bytes/Store schema and retired monitor/resource counters stay unavailable, with actual current bytes, identities and storage observations reported separately.

Native preparation writes and verifies every byte. Class A source-page and host metadata coldness are unavailable, so any complete functional observation is numerically INELIGIBLE; no cache warmth or unchanged repeated sample qualifies it.

Global Store is explicitly Disposable/WAL/OFF, overlay MEMORY/OFF/EXCLUSIVE. Host Init retains original uncapped CPU and sampled host RSS2GiB bound. The fresh verifier daemon/workload retains original2CPU/2GiB/no-swap/256PID/OOM controls,4GiB main Store,2GiB owned spool and zero after cleanup, with current scopes declared.
